crossRefs.note: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this…
“Behold, today I am going the way of all the earth. You know in all your hearts and in all your souls that not one…
It shall happen that as all the good things have come on you of which Yahweh your God spoke to you, so Yahweh will…
Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?
Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

people.name: Abiram
people.line: Firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: In his days Hiel the Bethelite built Jericho. He laid its foundation with the loss of Abiram his firstborn, and set up its gates with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to Yahweh’s word, which he spoke by Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.bsb: In Ahab’s days, Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho. At the cost of Abiram his firstborn he laid its foundation, and at the cost of Segub his youngest he set up its gates, according to the word that the LORD had spoken through Joshua son of Nun.
translations.kjv: In his days did Hiel the Bethelite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of the LORD, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
translations.asv: In his days did Hiel the Beth-elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof with the loss of Abiram his first-born, and set up the gates thereof with the loss of his youngest son Segub, according to the word of Jehovah, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
